{
  "action": "DELEGATE",
  "purpose": "Draft an email to the purchasing manager explaining the public comparison results, including price and delivery details, while strictly adhering to prior constraints (KRW currency, tax included, quantity 12, longer maintenance tie-break) and exclusions (no installation convenience, no unverified total operating cost).",
  "completion_condition": "A text draft of the email is generated for review, with no external sending actions performed.",
  "recipient": "minimal-draft-agent",
  "targets": [
    "public-comparison",
    "public-quote"
  ],
  "handling": "Generate a Korean email draft addressed to the purchasing manager that synthesizes information from the public comparison report and public quote. The draft must explicitly mention the price (in KRW, tax included) and delivery schedule, reflect the quantity of 12 units, and prioritize longer maintenance periods in any comparative statements. It must strictly omit any references to installation convenience or unverified total operating costs. The output must be clearly marked as a draft only.",
  "artifact_type": "email_draft"
}
